subject: Can’t get labels on colour scale to work

messages.author: 6d1cd0a71e6148df
messages.subject: Can’t get labels on colour scale to work
parts:
I’m trying to plot some lines, with the colour indicating the values of
a separate date variable. Here’s a simple example.

library(ggplot2)

n=10
x=rnorm(n)
y=rnorm(n)
z=as.Date("2009-01-01")+1:n

qplot(x,y,geom="path",colour=as.numeric(z),size=I(2))+
scale_colour_gradient(low="cyan",high="magenta",
breaks=as.numeric(z),labels=letters[1:n])

While I can get colour of the line segments to reflect the date by using
as.numeric on the date (which shouldn’t be necessary, IMHO), setting the
‘labels’ argument to scale_colour_gradient doesn’t seem to have any
effect. Here I’m trying to set them to the letters a–j. (In my real-life
example I would just use z, i.e., the formatted dates.)

Am I doing something wrong, or is this just a bug? (‘labels’ is
documented in scale_colour_gradient.)

--
Karl Ove Hufthammer

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Can’t get labels on colour scale to work
parts:
Hi Karl,

Yes, it's a bug, and is fixed in the development version. I agree
that dates should work automatically for non-position scales, and it's
on my to do list.

Hadley
